part.text: The file has complete calendar-year coverage for 2013–2025. Summing `number_of_pedestrians_killed` by crash year gives annual totals from 101 to 176; I’m preparing two distinct views of those same counts: a year-by-year bar chart and a trend line.

input.command:
python -c '
import duckdb, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from pathlib import Path
out = Path("out")
path = "data/crashes.parquet"
df = duckdb.connect().execute("SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM crash_date)::INT AS year, SUM(number_of_pedestrians_killed)::INT AS pedestrian_deaths FROM read_parquet(?) WHERE crash_date >= ? AND crash_date < ? GROUP BY year ORDER BY year", [path, "2013-01-01", "2026-01-01"]).df()
df = df.set_index("year").reindex(range(2013, 2026), fill_value=0).rename_axis("year").reset_index()
for i in (1, 2):
    df.to_csv(out / f"values_{i}.csv", index=False)
plt.figure(figsize=(11, 6))
plt.bar(df.year, df.pedestrian_deaths, color="#3977a8", width=0.72)
plt.title("Pedestrians killed in NYC motor vehicle crashes by year")
plt.xlabel("Crash year")
plt.ylabel("Pedestrian deaths (count)")
plt.xticks(df.year, rotation=45)
plt.ylim(0, 200)
plt.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.25)
for x, y in zip(df.year, df.pedestrian_deaths): plt.text(x, y + 3, str(y), ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig(out / "option_1.png", dpi=160)
plt.close()
plt.figure(figsize=(11, 6))
plt.plot(df.year, df.pedestrian_deaths, color="#c4553d", marker="o", linewidth=2)
plt.title("Annual trend in pedestrians killed in NYC motor vehicle crashes")
plt.xlabel("Crash year")
plt.ylabel("Pedestrian deaths (count)")
plt.xticks(df.year, rotation=45)
plt.ylim(0, 200)
plt.grid(alpha=0.25)
for x, y in zip(df.year, df.pedestrian_deaths): plt.annotate(str(y), (x, y), xytext=(0, 8), textcoords="offset points", ha="center", fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig(out / "option_2.png", dpi=160)
plt.close()
print(df.to_string(index=False))
'
